issues.description: compile_notebook RPC bloated to ship full script content instead of fetching on demand.
issues.detail: The backend writes the file to disk and returns its path, but now also stuffs the entire script content into every compile response. This inflates the RPC envelope with unbounded payload for one optional button. Add a dedicated download/read_script RPC the frontend invokes on click, or specify the new contract explicitly with size bounds.

issues.description: open(script_path) lacks encoding and error handling, conflating read failure with compile failure.
issues.detail: The file is opened without encoding='utf-8', so the returned string depends on server locale. Any IOError after a successful compile_pipeline propagates as a compile_notebook failure, poisoning the real result. Separate the read failure mode from compilation, or specify encoding and guard the read.

issues.description: Download icon renders unconditionally while handler silently no-ops when compiledContent is missing.
issues.detail: The button is shown in the success branch, but handleDownloadClick guards on compiledPath && compiledContent and returns silently on failure. Older backends, error paths, or future callers produce a hostile dead click. Either make compiledContent required at the type level for this branch or hide/disable the icon when absent.

issues.description: GetAppIcon used as a click target instead of a real button.
issues.detail: The SVG icon receives onClick and titleAccess but is not a button, has no keyboard handler, no role, and no focus semantics. The adjacent 'Done' affordance uses an anchor for a reason. Wrap in IconButton or use <a download> with an object URL to match the surrounding code and basic accessibility.

issues.description: DeployProgress complects progress rendering with file-download mechanics.
issues.detail: handleDownloadClick embeds Blob construction, object URL lifecycle, DOM manipulation, and revoke logic inside a component whose abstraction is 'render deploy progress.' Extract a downloadFile(name, content) utility so the component's contract stays focused and the download mechanism is substitutable and testable in isolation.

issues.description: Duplicated compiledPath and compiledContent state drilled through multiple components without a documented lifetime.
issues.detail: compiledPath is used only to derive a filename via split('/').pop() with a fabricated fallback, while compiledContent is added to DeployProgressState with no documented invariant for when it is set, cleared, or bounded. Carry one canonical representation, document its lifetime, and stop prop-drilling both through four files.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus that the feature is reasonable but the shape is wrong. The compile_notebook RPC has been quietly broadened to ship full script content as a side effect of compilation, with no encoding, no error isolation, and no size bound — the correct design is a dedicated download/read RPC invoked on click. On the frontend, the download icon renders unconditionally while its handler silently no-ops, the SVG is used as a click target instead of a real button, and download mechanics are complected with progress rendering. Fix the RPC shape, gate or type the button precondition, and extract the download utility.
